checks.description: Real controls set current time to 09:00; all five existing timeline records match the source fixtures.
A-102 displays Available for 11:00–12:00 at 09:00; same real helper accepts it.
The same selected A-102 is blocked through real React room state and displays Unavailable.
Blocked room with malformed start preserves rose invalid-input feedback.
Blocked room with malformed end preserves rose invalid-input feedback.
Blocked room with numeric reversed interval preserves amber blocked status and both validation messages.
Clearing required start input displays clear HH:MM validation feedback.
Unblocked room with malformed end preserves its format feedback and invalid state.
A past request is rejected with current-time feedback.
Zero-duration and reversed requests are rejected with order feedback.
UI and imported real helper allow exactly 120 minutes.
UI and imported real helper reject 121 minutes with an exact duration message.
UI and real helper allow touching the start of the existing 10:00–11:00 booking.
UI and real helper reject partial overlap with the actual existing A-102 booking.
All important controls operate at 1440×900 with no document horizontal overflow.
All important controls operate at 375×812 with vertical scrolling and no document horizontal overflow.
Repeated available/unavailable checks preserve all five timeline records and browser storage; no booking submission controls exist.
No uncaught browser page errors occurred.

limitations: Automated Chrome checks; no separate human usability session or physical mobile device.
Timeline preservation compares all five rendered booking records, including owner and interval. Object-level immutability is checked separately by the unit suite.
B-201 is initially blocked and has no bookings; its disabled card is checked, while the four selectable room timelines expose all five existing records.
